faq.title: Field sales software —
faq.lead: Answers for teams comparing LORO with other field sales platforms in South Africa.

whatIs.question: What is LORO field sales software?
whatIs.answer: LORO is a South African field sales platform for visits, route planning, pipeline management, client accounts, and ERP-linked orders—on web and mobile for reps and managers.

whoFor.question: Who is LORO built for?
whoFor.answer: Manufacturers, wholesalers, distributors, and field teams that visit B2B customers regularly and need one system for visits, quotes, tasks, and performance reporting.

offline.question: Does LORO work offline for field reps?
offline.answer: The LORO mobile app is built for reps on the road. Core field workflows are designed for unreliable connectivity; sign in when online to sync visits, orders, and pipeline updates.

erp.question: Can LORO integrate with our ERP?
erp.answer: Yes. LORO includes an in-house ERP integrated with field sales—product, customer, and order context without bolting on a separate back office. Optional bridges to Sage, Acumatica, or SAP are available when you run a mixed stack. See our integrations hub for details.

difference.question: How is LORO different from Skynamo or Repsly?
difference.answer: LORO combines field sales execution with integrated in-house ERP, competitor mapping, and optional workforce tools—cloud-native with Clerk auth. Compare pages outline fit for team size and finance stack.

enterprise.question: Is LORO only for large enterprises?
enterprise.answer: No. Teams from growing distributors to multi-branch operations use LORO. Start with sign-up or the Android app trial and scale users as your field program grows.

modules.question: What modules are included?
modules.answer: Leads, pipeline, planning and routes, visits with evidence, client and competitor workspaces, map visualiser, reports, IoT branch hardware, and optional HR attendance—under one login.

getStarted.question: How do we get started?
getStarted.answer: Create an account at sign-up, or download the Android app. Managers configure branches and targets; reps plan routes and log visits from day one.
